title: Truncate
summary: TRUNC'ATE, verb transitive [Latin trunco, to cut off.] To cut off; to lop; to maim. TRUNC'ATE, adjective In botany, appearing as if cut off at the tip; ending in a transverse line; as a truncate leaf.
